newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Celsius Bofors unit wins Venezuela order.
newsitem.headline: Celsius Bofors unit wins Venezuela order.

text.p: Bofors, a unit of Swedish defence group Celsius, said on Wednesday it had won an important order for man-portable, anti-armour weapons from the Venezuelan army and navy.

The order included a confined space weapon system, AT4 CS, the latest version of the AT4 system, and ammunition for the Carl-Gustaf multi-purpose weapon and a further procurement of the AT4 system, Bofors said in a statement.
"This makes Venezuela the third country to procure the AT4 CS after Denmark and France," Bofors said without disclosing the order value.
